question: Who joined as the CEO of NITI Aayog in February 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**B.V.R. Subrahmanyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **B.V.R. Subrahmanyam** was appointed as the CEO of **NITI Aayog** in **February 2023**, succeeding **Parameswaran Iyer**.

• He is a 1987 batch Indian Administrative Service (**IAS**) officer of the **Chhattisgarh cadre**.

• Prior to his appointment, B.V.R. Subrahmanyam served as **Chairman and Managing Director of the India Trade Promotion Organisation (ITPO)**, which is responsible for managing India’s largest exhibition complex, Pragati Maidan.

• He has held several key positions in the Indian government, including serving as the **Chief Secretary of Jammu and Kashmir**, where he played a crucial role in the region's administrative and developmental changes post its reorganization in **2019**.
